summary: Inhibrx Biosciences filed a Form 8-K furnishing a September 8, 2026 press release and disclosing updated Phase 2 HexAgon results under Items 7.01 and 8.01. INBRX-106 plus pembrolizumab produced a 48.3% confirmed objective response rate versus 26.5% for pembrolizumab monotherapy in first-line PD-L1-positive HNSCC, with median progression-free survival of 9.6 versus 4.9 months and stronger HPV-positive activity. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, or deal terms were stated. This is a routine clinical-update current report, not a special situation; watch regulatory and pivotal-trial next steps.
